name: Crossroads of the World
description: Crossroads of the World is a historic outdoor shopping complex on Sunset Boulevard in Hollywood, built in 1936 and designed to resemble an ocean liner surrounded by village-style cottages representing different countries. This architectural landmark features a distinctive streamline moderne central building with a revolving globe on top, surrounded by themed bungalows housing creative offices and boutique retail spaces. Designated as a Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument, it serves as a unique blend of commercial and creative office space in the heart of Hollywood.
summary: A historic 1936 architectural landmark in Hollywood featuring a nautical-themed central building and international village-style cottages housing creative offices and boutique retail.
